[spoiler=Operation Shield][i]Sunday, 26 July[/i]
1,000,000 troops from Western View, as well as 1,000 M48 Pattons, and 400 F-4s, 200 A-10s, 300 A-4s, 75 B-52, 100 C-130s, and half of the Wessernian fleet head out in route to IDZRC, in West Shamat. It is a multi-day journey in between Elseyr and the Vespurias, then into the Balwick sea, and eventually in the Argos strait to end up in the city of Western View, based off of Western View. Farther inland in West Shamat, 1,000,000 Baladullan troops, as well as 100 T-90 tanks, and 500 mobile SAM launchers start their land route down to the Southern end of West Shamat. 
[i]Wednesday, 29 July[/i]
Generals, and an admiral shake hands out side of the IDZRC border, then they start to mobilize, surrounding IDZRC, but they don't place a single weapon inside of IDZRC, for that would break the demilitarization zone. They sit and wait, ships dock on the other side of the Argos strait, planes land on dirt runways, and soldiers sleep in make shift tents. They wait and protect IDZC, they will shoot at anything that does not clarify where they are going (if they enter the IDZRC radar area) suply trucks, boat and planes resupply the area now known as the Iron Wall.[/spoiler]
